scientific_integrity: Explicit finite irreducible Markov generators, exact stationary spectrum formulas and symbolic inequalities establish the theorem. Finite exact-rational checks are auxiliary and do not certify infinite limiting arguments or publication priority.
scientific_limitations: The 12/5 amplification is sharp only for the specified two-slow-site directed cycle and fast-state-supported observable family in the intermediate-frequency asymptotic. The global five-state oscillation efficiency has only the established lower bound 7/12; equality is not claimed. The directed dynamics have infinite stochastic-thermodynamic entropy production. Potential general-resolvent subsumption remains a publication-priority risk.
title: A sharp mesoscopic spectral-amplification witness for five-state Markov oscillators
